title: Characterization of local acceptance
statement: Let a Boolean proof-checking system make $r$ nonadaptive queries, fix a random seed, and let $a\in\{-1,1\}^r$ be a sign assignment to the query positions. Convert each sign in $a$ to its corresponding bit, and form the local transcript by placing that bit at each queried position and leaving unqueried positions blank. The local acceptance function takes the value $-1$ at $a$ if and only if the verifier accepts this transcript.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean proof-checking system with query count $r$
A sign assignment on the $r$ query positions
